title: Alexia's Vanilla Plus Recipies
description: Adds new vanilla plus crafting and blasting recipies.
body:
Adds various vanilla plus crafting and blasting recipies. 

Helpful additions include:
- Blasting raw copper, iron, and gold blocks. 
- Blasting cobblestone, stone, and deepslate. 
- De-crafting blue ice, packed ice, amethyst blocks, nether wart blocks, and wool. 
- Craftable budding amethyst, green dye and brown dye. 
- Returning glass panes and carpet to their full block forms. 

And more to discover.
